Galileo TrakWheel Tires offer superior performance through an innovative design featuring a concave sidewall and an elongated footprint that functions like a track. This unique tire structure allows for high radial flexibility, ensuring a uniformly distributed, extended footprint even under extreme loads. Each wheel operates independently, and the rubber flex design reduces damage and prevents getting stuck.


Designed to endure tough agricultural environments and heavy irrigation loads, these agricultural and Irrigation TRAKWHEEL tires outlast conventional ones. Their optimized shape also minimizes soil compaction and increases surface contact. Our range includes tires for irrigation pivots, agriculture and construction, revolutionizing these industries by reducing the need for frequent tire replacements and repairs. All our advanced tires, whether you are looking for airless or non-airless, will save you money and minimize downtime, simplifying farming operations and enhancing productivity.
